conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a great observation; many traditions worldwide emphasize community and shared experiences. For instance, the Maasai Eunoto ceremony in East Africa focuses on young warriors transitioning into adulthood.
